kind.description: The session's intent. `consultiva` (consultative) is conversation only; `criativa` (creative) is the one that produces — it opens ideation with the Creative agent and is the only one that enters execution. REQUIRED: without it the response is 400, because the type is the opener's choice and gets recorded.

name.description: Friendly name, optional. Does not replace the id's hashtag — screens compose the two. Blank counts as absent.
